USE aer_synapse_db;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. RUN STAMP + SOURCE WINDOW
-- @StartDate/@EndDate come from the pipeline (same watermark
-- window as PL_EIA_IncrementalIngestion), NOT today's date --
-- Bronze is partitioned by start_date=/end_date=, not by a
-- flat run date.
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @StartDate NVARCHAR(10) = '@{pipeline().parameters.StartDate}';
DECLARE @EndDate   NVARCHAR(10) = '@{pipeline().parameters.EndDate}';

DECLARE @RunStamp NVARCHAR(25) =
    REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120), '-', '')
    + '_'
    + REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', '');

DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(200) = 'dbo.fact_oilprice_' + @RunStamp;
DECLARE @Location  NVARCHAR(400) =
    '/gold/fact_oilprice/' + @StartDate + '_' + @EndDate + '/run_' + @RunStamp + '/';
DECLARE @BronzePath NVARCHAR(400) =
    '/bronze/oilprice/start_date=' + @StartDate + '/end_date=' + @EndDate + '/*.parquet';

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DROP EXISTING EXTERNAL TABLE METADATA IF RE-RUNNING
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @DropSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'IF OBJECT_ID(''' + @TableName + N''') IS NOT NULL DROP EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @TableName + N';';
EXEC sp_executesql @DropSQL;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. CETAS: Bronze EIA Parquet -> Gold OilPrice Parquet
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @TableName + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''' + @Location + N''',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    TRY_CAST([period] AS DATE) AS PriceDate,
    TRY_CAST([value] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OilPrice_USD,
    [series-description] AS SeriesDescription,
    GETDATE() AS Loaded_At
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK ''' + @BronzePath + N''',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b
WHERE [period] IS NOT NULL
  AND [value] IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST([value] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) IS NOT NULL;';

EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;
